info.longName: Strategy Shares Nasdaq 7 Handl Index ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in securities of the NASDAQ 7 HANDL™ Index (the "index"). The index consists of securities issued by exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") and is split into two components, with a 50% allocation to fixed income and equity ETFs (the "Core Portfolio") and a 50% allocation to ETFs of 12 asset categories (the "Explore Portfolio").
